outlook.discussion: 1. Eastern East Pacific (EP96): Recent satellite wind data indicates that a small area of low pressure located more than one hundred miles offshore of Nicaragua and El Salvador has a well-defined circulation and is producing winds of 30-35 mph near its center. However, the associated shower and thunderstorm activity has become less organized near its center.
